name: Dry Swab on Dried Stain
description: This stain had already dried, so it needed a moistened swab. A dry swab barely picks anything up!

name: Wet Swab on Wet Stain
description: This stain was still wet, so a dry swab was the right choice. Adding water just dilutes the sample. Save the dilution for the lab!

name: Test Swab Collected
description: You packaged the swab you ran the presumptive test on. The chemicals contaminate it, so collect a fresh sample for the lab!

name: No Presumptive Test
description: You failed to run a presumptive test. For all you know, it could be paint!

name: Wrong Blood Test Order
description: You mixed up the steps of the Kastle-Meyer test. The order is ethanol, then phenolphthalein, then hydrogen peroxide.

name: Wrong Powder
description: You reached for magnetic powder. It clings to a steel blade instead of the print, so it's the wrong choice for a knife.

name: Missing Evidence
description: You failed to collect a piece of evidence. Don't push yourself too hard; it's not like anybody's future is on the line.

name: Computer Not Inspected
description: You never looked through the victim's computer. Who knows what you missed?
